scenario: Aggregate buckets, daily activity summaries, and a profile snapshot
notes: Two aggregate buckets (one with a value and temporal contexts, one explicit-null 'empty bucket'), two activity summaries (one with localDate and temporal context, one legacy-style with only the epoch-ms date and null rings), and a profile line that clears name and email while setting date of birth and sex. Aggregates and summaries are upserts; a replay overwrites the same rows.
